lines.text: Monday morning. Four agents have a question for you, and all at the same time.
Which one do you answer first? Without a view, it is just panic and guessing.
If the questions are scattered across chats and terminals, ranking them is nearly impossible.
On the board, every question sits in one place, in order, so you see everything at a glance.
Each card carries its status, its owner, and the exact request, so you can rank them in seconds.
The blocker comes first, because a blocked agent makes everything behind it wait.
You add the key, and Cursor is unblocked with a single reply.
Second, the deploy. The card shows exactly what the agent wants to run.
The color scheme is not urgent, so it simply waits for later.
One minute of triage, and three agents are moving again.
A clear queue turns a panicky Monday into a calm one.
How do you decide which agent to unblock first? Tell us your triage rules below, or try it at Agent R Q dot com.
